_comment: The last call (Act 7). Hale's cleanup crew is down, the splinter is in V's hand,
and nobody is coming for the next few minutes. This is the scene that decides how
Ash Cache ends: every option sets exactly one ashcache_end_* fact, and the quest
graph's br_* chain reads those facts to pick the epilogue.
Why TWO entry points instead of one hub with a conditional option:
the Hide ending only exists if Mara is alive and trusted (D3, gate_hide). The
obvious way to express that is a questCondition on a scnChoiceNodeOption. That
field turned out to be real - 1,177 vanilla scenes use it (D26) - and gen_scene.py
now emits it. It is still not used here, because a failing condition REMOVES the
option rather than greying it, so it buys nothing this shape does not already do.
So the branch lives in the .questphase graph instead, which is where rule 1 wants
quest logic anyway: route_hide reads ashcache_hide_available and enters this scene
at decide_in or decide_in_hide. Same player-facing result, only proven machinery.
The two openings are not the same lines twice. The hide path's opening is the
reason its fourth option exists - Mara is still breathing and she named a place -
so the branch reads as a consequence rather than as an extra button.
_actors: Deliberately empty: V is alone. A scnActorDef is a SPAWN instruction, not a
reference to somebody already standing there, so casting Mara here would
conjure her into the room on the branches where ashcache_mara_dead or
ashcache_mara_hostile is set - a corpse that walks in for the finale.
A cast of nobody-but-V is a shipped shape, not an extrapolation: Undermine's
dialog_only_template.scene has 0 actors and 1 scnPlayerActorDef, with a section
node, two scnDialogLineEvents and two scnQuestNodes - the same parts this file
uses. The choice hub then falls back to mode 'attachToScreen', which is what
Undermine's template.scene ships for its own hub. Both checked in json_out/.

nodes._comment: Same cinematic framing as the Mara confrontation: V stands still and cannot draw a weapon while choosing what to do with the splinter. Tier3 is the first rung that stops movement (Tier2 only caps walking speed). Paired with 'tier_off'; the questphase wires this scene's Default INT/RET because of it.

lines.en-us: Hale's crew came for a box. Not one of them asked what was inside it.
lines.ua-ua: Команда Гейла прийшла по кейс. І жоден з них не спитав, що всередині.

lines.en-us: Twenty minutes, she said. Most of them are gone.
lines.ua-ua: Двадцять хвилин, казала вона. Більшості з них уже нема.

lines.en-us: Hale's crew is down. The case is still in my hands, and it's still warm.
lines.ua-ua: Команда Гейла лежить. Кейс досі в мене в руках — і досі теплий.

lines.en-us: Mara's still breathing. After nine years of waiting for this, that's not nothing.
lines.ua-ua: Мара досі дихає. Після дев'яти років чекання на це — вже немало.

lines.en-us: And she named a place. Somewhere the FIA stopped looking a long time ago.
lines.ua-ua: І вона назвала місце. Там, де ФІА давно перестало шукати.

nodes._comment: Three options. Same three the hide hub opens with - only the ids differ, because a locstring ruid is allocated per option id and two hubs cannot share one.

options.en-us: Burn it. Nobody gets to read me.
Jack in. I want to hear the echo.
There's a man with blue eyes who'll take it off my hands.
options.ua-ua: Є чоловік із блакитними очима — він забере його в мене.

options.en-us: Burn it. Nobody gets to read me.
Jack in. I want to hear the echo.
There's a man with blue eyes who'll take it off my hands.
options.ua-ua: Є чоловік із блакитними очима — він забере його в мене.

options.en-us: Bury it where the FIA stopped looking.
options.ua-ua: Закопати там, де ФІА перестало шукати.

lines.en-us: Whatever it thought I'd do next - it got this one wrong.
lines.ua-ua: Що б він не думав, що я зроблю далі — тут він помилився.

lines.en-us: Nine years in a wall and it's still talking. Fine. Say it to my face.
lines.ua-ua: Дев'ять років у стіні, а він досі говорить. Гаразд. Скажи мені це в обличчя.

lines.en-us: He already knew where it was. He just needed somebody else's hands on it.
lines.ua-ua: Він і так знав, де воно. Йому просто потрібні були чужі руки.

lines.en-us: Another nine years. Maybe by then nobody remembers what to look for.
lines.ua-ua: Ще дев'ять років. Може, до того часу ніхто вже не пам'ятатиме, що шукати.

nodes._comment: One ending fact per branch. The graph's br_* chain reads exactly these, in order, and br_hide re-tests the D3 gate on its own - so even a hub that somehow offered Hide when it should not have cannot reach an ending Mara is not alive to play.

Set last, after the ending fact, so a save taken between the two can never show 'decided' with no decision recorded. The graph no longer waits on it - the scene's own exit drives the flow - but it stays set because it is the save-game record that Act 7 happened, and the CET console uses it to jump there.
